whatsappMessage:
Hi Suto jee bhar ke Team,

I noticed your dining/food spot has wonderful 4.7★ reviews on Buddh Marg in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for direct orders and table inquiries.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp ordering, menu showcase, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/suto

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Team Suto jee bhar ke, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp ordering and your Buddh Marg location highlights. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
